The applicant was charged with membership of an illegal organisation under Article 314 § 2 of the Criminal Code (Law no. 5237), on the basis of Articles 220 § 6 and 314 § 3 of the same Code.

The Diyarbakır public prosecutor claimed in the indictment that the applicant had regularly, willingly and knowingly participated in illegal demonstrations organised by political parties, associations and persons who supported the PKK.

The Diyarbakır public prosecutor claimed in the indictment that the applicant should be punished for membership of an illegal organisation on the basis of his regular participation in illegal demonstrations organised by supporters of the PKK.
